title: Nine Seconds of Advice
subtitle: 一点与少量 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 一点与少量（生活与学习·日常与度量）
meta: 主题语境：一点与少量（生活与学习·日常与度量）　|　核心词汇：bit　|　正文 344 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 bit 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1953 my uncle was given ① a bit of advice that took nine seconds and used for eleven years, and my grandmother said the nine seconds were the whole of the gift. The ② bit, meaning the piece and not the advice, was written down in March and was never looked at again; a bit, he said, is the only thing you can be given that is smaller than what it does.

Every ③ bit in that house belonged to the horse first, and the ④ bit with the rusty ring, meaning the one kept on a nail by the door and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever touched. A bit, my mother said, is nine parts iron and one part an animal willing to agree; my uncle said the iron is the part that lasts.

My father meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ bit was the whole of the tool, meaning the drilling end and not the piece. The ⑥ bit, meaning the part that cuts and not any of that, is the only thing in a box that everybody borrows and nobody returns sharp; a bit, he said, is either a small piece or the only word that means both a fragment and a tool. She said the fragment came first.

By 1966 the ⑦ bit had become a photograph in a catalogue, and the catalogue had become an argument about the size. The ⑧ bit of the whole thing, my uncle wrote in April, was nine seconds of advice and eleven years of use; a bit, he said, is either the thing on the nail or the reason you learned to listen quickly. She said the listening was the part that mattered.

The ⑨ bit I remember is the one on the nail, which was taken down in 1969 and never put back. A ⑩ bit, my grandmother said in 1971, is the only thing that improves by being small; every bit, she said, is a tool that has agreed to look like a fragment. He said the tool was never the small part.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: B. n. 一点（指那一小片，与建议相对）
C. 固定搭配：be given a bit of advice 得到一点建议
D. n. 小块／一点（指屋里每一样小东西）
E. n. 马嚼子（指门边钉子上那一个）
F. n. 钻头；刀头（指工具切削的那一部分）
G. n. 钻头（抽象：切削的那个部件）
H. n. 权衡；整件事的分量（抽象总称）

items.q: a bit of advice that took nine seconds
The bit, meaning the piece and not the advice
the bit with the rusty ring
bit was the whole of the tool
The bit, meaning the part that cuts
the bit had become a photograph in a catalogue
The bit of the whole thing
A bit, my grandmother said in 1971

answers.why: be given a bit of advice 意为“得到一点建议”，1953 年叔叔得到一点只花了九秒钟的建议，却用了十一年。
bit 意为“一点”，指那一小片而不是建议，它三月被写下来，此后再没被看过。
bit 指屋里每一样小东西，那屋里每一样原先都是属于马的。
bit 意为“马嚼子”，指挂在门边钉子上的那一个（带锈环的），是唯一有人碰过的。
bit 意为“钻头、刀头”，指工具上切削的那一部分，父亲说 bit 就是那件工具的全部。
bit 为抽象用法，指切削的那个部件，是工具箱里人人都借、却没人还回来时还锋利的东西。
bit 意为“一点、小块”，到 1966 年这个 bit 成了商品目录里的一张照片。
bit 意为“权衡、整件事的分量”，叔叔四月写道，整件事权衡下来是九秒钟的建议和十一年的受用。
bit 意为“一点、小东西”，我记得的是钉子上那一个，1969 年被取下，再没挂回去。
bit 为抽象总称，祖母说一点点东西是唯一会因为小而变好的。
